The '''Ice Citadel''' was a building on [[Jebble]]. It was used as a [[Neo-Crusader War Forge|war forge]] by the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] in [[3963 BBY]].
